_comment: O-B row split (card t_59289f80, Thomas-Gesetz 04.11.: Offiziere wuerfen keine Vorstoss-Doktrin mehr): the single officer row {DG004,DG005,DG006,DG075,DG078 | aggressive 45/guard 35/blocker 15/hunter 5} became THREE id rows - DG004+DG005 support 55/guard 25/blocker 10/hunter 10, DG006 support 55/guard 20/blocker 10/hunter 15, DG075+DG078 (field commanders, id-pinned, weights BYTE-IDENTICAL to the old row). The officers lose aggressive entirely (O-C emergency codex covers self-defense); DG075/DG078 keep their exact old distribution. postureModifiers is the SHARED default row set: Effective() adds the posture delta additively onto any row, support has no modifier entry and passes through untouched - the defend case below proves the inheritance arithmetic. Old DG004 hunt was {aggressive 45, guard 35, blocker 15, hunter 5}; old defend {aggressive 20, guard 55, blocker 30} (hunter clamped to 0). All new expect blocks are hand-computed from the row weights + the pinned defend modifier row (no rolls, no --record needed); every PRE-O-B case row is byte-identical (git diff proof in the commit).
